title: Les observations anatomo-cliniques du Service de R.T.H. Laennec à l’Hôpital Necker (1816–1819)
version: Histoire des sciences médicales, vol. 30, no. 2, pp. 221–224. Société française d’Histoire de la Médecine scan hosted by Université Paris Cité.
lineage: Original historical analysis of 66 manuscript case notes held in the Fonds du Musée Laennec in Nantes; its December 1817 example is distinct from Observation III in the published treatise.

passages.note: The case notes were kept by the interns; Dubois reports that mediate auscultation first appears in his manuscript sample in the seventh observation, dated December 1817.
Describes repeated, dated examinations and comparisons with autopsy findings.
